requirement: Generate and validate URL slugs, using Hypothesis st.from_regex with fullmatch so the strategy only yields strings that the validator accepts.
skeleton: A SlugError, an NFKD-folding slugify with safe truncation, a fullmatch-based is_slug, and a slugs strategy built from the same regex.
caption: URL slug helpers with a Hypothesis strategy, using re, unicodedata and hypothesis strategies. SlugError is a ValueError subclass. slugify folds accents with NFKD normalization, drops non-ASCII, lowercases, joins runs of other characters with single dashes, strips edge dashes, truncates to MAX_LEN and strips a dash left by truncation, raising SlugError when nothing remains. is_slug requires a fullmatch of the slug pattern within MAX_LEN, and slugs builds valid slugs with st.from_regex using fullmatch=True filtered by length. The fixture asserts, with derandomized settings, generated slugs are valid fixed points, slugify output is always a slug, accent folding, truncation without a trailing dash, SlugError cases and malformed slug rejection.

plan.intent: Build URL slugs for blog posts
constraints: slugify raises SlugError when no slug characters remain
Accents fold to ASCII through NFKD normalization
Truncation to MAX_LEN never leaves a trailing dash
is_slug matches the whole text, not a prefix

rationale.teaches: Derive the strategy and the validator from one regex and require whole-string matches in both.
rationale.why: from_regex without fullmatch and re.match both accept strings that only start with a valid slug, so invalid URLs slip through.

ops.docstring: URL slugs with a validator and a Hypothesis from_regex strategy.

ops.stmt: from hypothesis import strategies as st

ops.source:
class SlugError(ValueError):
    """Raised when a title has no characters usable in a slug."""

def slugify(title: str) -> str:
    """Return a lowercase ASCII slug of at most MAX_LEN characters."""
    folded = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title)
    ascii_title = folded.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", ascii_title.lower()).strip("-")
    slug = slug[:MAX_LEN].rstrip("-")
    if not slug:
        raise SlugError(f"cannot build a slug from {title!r}")
    return slug

candidates.why_wrong: Generated slugs carry arbitrary junk around the matching part.
A long title truncated at a separator ends with a dash.
Text that merely begins with a slug, like a--b, is accepted.
Accented letters are dropped instead of folded, so Crème becomes crme.
Punctuation-only titles produce an empty slug instead of an error.
